  class IntersectionLoader {
    #observer;
    constructor(threshold = 0.1) {
      this.#observer = new IntersectionObserver(entries => {
        for (const entry of entries) {
          if (!entry.isIntersecting) continue;
          const el = entry.target;
          if (el.dataset.src) el.src = el.dataset.src;
          if (el.dataset.bg) el.style.backgroundImage = `url(${el.dataset.bg})`;
          this.#observer.unobserve(el);
        }
      }, { threshold });
    }
    observe(el) { this.#observer.observe(el); }

<body>
  <canvas id="canvas" width="600" height="400" style="border:1px solid #ccc"></canvas>
  <script>
    const canvas = document.getElementById('canvas');
    const ctx = canvas.getContext('2d');
    let drawing = false, last = {};

    canvas.addEventListener('mousedown', e => { drawing = true; last = { x: e.offsetX, y: e.offsetY }; });
    canvas.addEventListener('mousemove', e => {
      if (!drawing) return;
      ctx.beginPath();
      ctx.moveTo(last.x, last.y);
      ctx.lineTo(e.offsetX, e.offsetY);
      ctx.strokeStyle = '#0062F3';
      ctx.lineWidth = 2;
      ctx.lineCap = 'round';
      ctx.stroke();
      last = { x: e.offsetX, y: e.offsetY };
    });
    canvas.addEventListener('mouseup', () => drawing = false);
    canvas.addEventListener('mouseleave', () => drawing = false);
  </script>
</body>

<script type="module">
  class Scheduler {
    #tasks = new Map();
    #rafId = null;

    schedule(id, fn, priority = 'normal') {
      this.#tasks.set(id, { fn, priority, queued: performance.now() });
      if (!this.#rafId) this.#rafId = requestAnimationFrame(() => this.#flush());
    }

    #flush() {
      this.#rafId = null;
      const deadline = performance.now() + 5;
      const sorted = [...this.#tasks.entries()].sort(([,a],[,b]) => a.priority === b.priority ? a.queued - b.queued : a.priority === 'high' ? -1 : 1);
      for (const [id, { fn }] of sorted) {
        if (performance.now() > deadline) { this.#rafId = requestAnimationFrame(() => this.#flush()); break; }
        fn();
        this.#tasks.delete(id);
      }
    }
  }
</script>

<script type="module">
  class SignalGraph {
    #nodes = new Map();
    #edges = new Map();
    #dirty = new Set();
    #running = null;

    createSignal(init) {
      const id = Symbol();
      this.#nodes.set(id, { value: init, subscribers: new Set() });
      return [
        () => { if (this.#running) this.#nodes.get(id).subscribers.add(this.#running); return this.#nodes.get(id).value; },
        v => { this.#nodes.get(id).value = v; this.#nodes.get(id).subscribers.forEach(e => this.#dirty.add(e)); this.#schedule(); },
      ];
    }

    createEffect(fn) {
      const effect = { fn, deps: new Set() };
      this.#running = effect;
      fn();
      this.#running = null;
      return () => effect.deps.forEach(d => d.delete(effect));
    }

    #schedule() {
      queueMicrotask(() => { this.#dirty.forEach(e => e.fn()); this.#dirty.clear(); });
    }
  }
</script>

<script type="module">
  async function* streamJSON(url) {
    const res = await fetch(url);
    const reader = res.body.getReader();
    const decoder = new TextDecoder();
    let buffer = '';
    while (true) {
      const { done, value } = await reader.read();
      if (done) break;
      buffer += decoder.decode(value, { stream: true });
      const lines = buffer.split('\n');
      buffer = lines.pop();
      for (const line of lines) {
        if (line.trim()) yield JSON.parse(line);
      }
    }
    if (buffer.trim()) yield JSON.parse(buffer);
  }
</script>

<script>
  class HookEngine {
    #current = null;
    #hooks = new WeakMap();

    useState(init) {
      const hooks = this.#hooks.get(this.#current);
      const index = hooks.cursor++;
      if (hooks.state.length <= index) hooks.state.push(typeof init === 'function' ? init() : init);
      const setState = v => {
        hooks.state[index] = typeof v === 'function' ? v(hooks.state[index]) : v;
        this.#rerender(this.#current);
      };
      return [hooks.state[index], setState];
    }

    useEffect(fn, deps) {
      const hooks = this.#hooks.get(this.#current);
      const index = hooks.cursor++;
      const prev = hooks.effects[index];
      const changed = !prev || deps?.some((d, i) => d !== prev.deps[i]);
      if (changed) {
        prev?.cleanup?.();
        hooks.effects[index] = { deps, cleanup: fn() };
      }
    }
  }
</script>

  const SUSPENSE = Symbol('suspense');

  function createSuspense(promise) {
    let status = 'pending', result;
    const suspension = promise.then(
      val => { status = 'resolved'; result = val; },
      err => { status = 'rejected'; result = err; }

  class CSP {

<script>
  class MessageBus {
    #channels = new Map();
    #middleware = [];

    use(fn) { this.#middleware.push(fn); return this; }

    subscribe(channel, handler) {
      if (!this.#channels.has(channel)) this.#channels.set(channel, new Set());
      this.#channels.get(channel).add(handler);
      return () => this.#channels.get(channel).delete(handler);
    }

    async publish(channel, data) {
      let payload = data;
      for (const mw of this.#middleware) payload = await mw(channel, payload);
      const handlers = this.#channels.get(channel);
      if (!handlers) return 0;
      await Promise.all([...handlers].map(h => h(payload)));
      return handlers.size;
    }
  }
</script>

<script type="module">
  class WorkerBridge {
    #worker;
    #pending = new Map();
    #id = 0;

    constructor(url) {
      this.#worker = new Worker(url, { type: 'module' });
      this.#worker.onmessage = ({ data: { id, result, error } }) => {
        const { resolve, reject } = this.#pending.get(id);
        this.#pending.delete(id);
        error ? reject(new Error(error)) : resolve(result);
      };

    call(method, ...args) {
      return new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
        const id = this.#id++;
        this.#pending.set(id, { resolve, reject });

<script type="module">
  class ReactiveDOM {
    static #tracker = null;

    static track(fn) {
      const subs = new Set();
      ReactiveDOM.#tracker = dep => subs.add(dep);
      fn();
      ReactiveDOM.#tracker = null;
      return subs;
    }

    static signal(init) {
      let val = init;
      const subscribers = new Set();
      return {
        get value() { ReactiveDOM.#tracker?.(subscribers); return val; },
        set value(v) { val = v; subscribers.forEach(fn => fn()); },
      };
    }

    static effect(fn) {
      const run = () => { const subs = ReactiveDOM.track(fn); subs.forEach(s => s.add(run)); };
      run();
    }
  }

<script type="module">
const registry = new Map();

function define(name, setup) {
  class Component extends HTMLElement {
    #cleanup = [];
    #state = new Map();

    connectedCallback() {
      const props = Object.fromEntries([...this.attributes].map(a => [a.name, a.value]));
      const { template, effects } = setup(props, {
        useState: (key, init) => {
          if (!this.#state.has(key)) this.#state.set(key, init);
          const val = this.#state.get(key);
          const set = v => { this.#state.set(key, v); this.#render(setup, props); };
          return [val, set];
        },
        onMount: fn => this.#cleanup.push(fn()),
      });
      this.innerHTML = typeof template === 'function' ? template() : template;
      effects?.forEach(fn => this.#cleanup.push(fn(this)));
    }

    disconnectedCallback() {
      this.#cleanup.forEach(fn => typeof fn === 'function' && fn());
    }

    #render(setup, props) {
      this.disconnectedCallback();
      this.#cleanup = [];
      this.connectedCallback();
    }
  }
  customElements.define(name, Component);
  registry.set(name, Component);
}
</script>

  <title>Advanced State Machine</title>

<script type="module">
function createMachine(config) {
  return {
    initial: config.initial,
    transition(state, event) {
      const stateConfig = config.states[state];
      if (!stateConfig) throw new Error(`Unknown state: ${state}`);
      const transition = stateConfig.on?.[event.type];
      if (!transition) return state;
      const next = typeof transition === 'string' ? transition : transition.target;
      const guard = typeof transition === 'object' ? transition.guard : null;
      if (guard && !guard(event)) return state;
      const exitActions = stateConfig.exit ?? [];
      const nextConfig = config.states[next];
      const entryActions = nextConfig?.entry ?? [];
      const transitionActions = typeof transition === 'object' ? (transition.actions ?? []) : [];
      return {
        state: next,
        actions: [...exitActions, ...transitionActions, ...entryActions],
      };
    },
    start() {
      return {
        value: config.initial,
        context: config.context ?? {},
        send(event) {
          const result = this._machine.transition(this.value, event);
          if (typeof result === 'string') this.value = result;
          else { this.value = result.state; result.actions.forEach(a => a(this.context, event)); }
        },
        _machine: this,
      };
    },
  };
}
</script>

<script type="module">
const ICE_SERVERS = [{ urls: 'stun:stun.l.google.com:19302' }];

class PeerConnection {
  #pc;
  #dataChannel;
  #onMessage;

  constructor(config = {}) {
    this.#pc = new RTCPeerConnection({ iceServers: ICE_SERVERS, ...config });
  }

  async createOffer() {
    this.#dataChannel = this.#pc.createDataChannel('chat', { ordered: true });
    this.#setupDataChannel(this.#dataChannel);
    const offer = await this.#pc.createOffer();
    await this.#pc.setLocalDescription(offer);
    return new Promise(resolve => {
      this.#pc.onicecandidate = ({ candidate }) => {
        if (!candidate) resolve(this.#pc.localDescription);
      };
    });
  }

  async createAnswer(offer) {
    await this.#pc.setRemoteDescription(offer);
    this.#pc.ondatachannel = ({ channel }) => this.#setupDataChannel(channel);
    const answer = await this.#pc.createAnswer();
    await this.#pc.setLocalDescription(answer);
    return new Promise(resolve => {
      this.#pc.onicecandidate = ({ candidate }) => {
        if (!candidate) resolve(this.#pc.localDescription);
      };
    });
  }

  async acceptAnswer(answer) {
    await this.#pc.setRemoteDescription(answer);
  }

  #setupDataChannel(channel) {
    this.#dataChannel = channel;
    channel.onopen = () => console.log('Data channel open');
    channel.onmessage = ({ data }) => this.#onMessage?.(data);
    channel.onerror = e => console.error('Channel error:', e);
  }

  onMessage(fn) { this.#onMessage = fn; return this; }

  send(data) {
    if (this.#dataChannel?.readyState === 'open') this.#dataChannel.send(data);
    else throw new Error('Channel not open');
  }

  close() { this.#pc.close(); }
}

// Signaling flow (simplified)
const peerA = new PeerConnection();
const peerB = new PeerConnection();
peerA.onMessage(msg => console.log('A received:', msg));
peerB.onMessage(msg => console.log('B received:', msg));
const offer = await peerA.createOffer();
const answer = await peerB.createAnswer(offer);
await peerA.acceptAnswer(answer);
